gallery.title: File:SH IN-MN.png
gallery.description:
In India, State Highways are marked by Milestone markers at regular intervals along the road. These markers indicate the distance travelled and also the status of the road. The Milestone markers are typically rectangular in shape and are painted in green with white lettering.
The green color represents the State Highway, while the text on it denotes the milestone number. For example, if the milestone marker shows "1" , it indicates that the current location is one mile away from the starting point of that particular State Highway.
It should be noted that the actual design and text used on the milestone markers may vary depending on the state and region. However, the overall purpose of the milestone marker remains the same, which is to provide travelers with information about their current location and distance covered on the State Highway.
Here is a list of State Highway markers for all the states:

hero.description: Loktak Lake, the largest freshwater (sweet) lake in northeast India, also called the floating lake due to the floating phumdis (heterogeneous mass of vegetation, soil, and organic matters at various stages of decomposition) on it, is located near Moirang in Manipur state, India.
